phases.0: VIEW: held load, a=0 b=12000 aux=original yaw; done=mode25 closed
phases.1: PULL: a=finite travel mm, b=signed pre-yaw cdeg, aux=original field travel heading; end yaw=aux if bit2 else aux-b, then return aux; empty done=mode3 open, loaded done=mode25 closed
phases.2: STAGE: held load, live a=remaining mm b=field travel heading aux=body yaw; a=0 then mode25 done closed

ownership: Original 0x1D/0x1E pairing; new phase/new pull new action; live stage updates same action; DONE only matching accepted action and actual completion
feature_flag: --enable-closed-deflect / RDK_ENABLE_CLOSED_DEFLECT=1; default off until lower deployed
scope: Only field side of own staging arrival window; current pose AND calibrated travel endpoint outside. At staging use original 0x14 safety sweep.

entries.VIEW: loaded formal NAV mode10 before staging completion only
entries.PULL: empty APP mode52; loaded NAV mode10 or completed same-task VIEW mode25; never ALIGN or completed phase2
entries.STAGE: loaded ALIGN mode11 or completed phase2; position correction only

successors.VIEW: same task new PULL or original STAGE NAV 0x03
successors.PULL: loaded: original STAGE NAV 0x03; empty: SEARCH mode3 after open/mechanical completion
successors.STAGE: original ALIGN then original 0x14 safety sweep; never PULL
